# EvoTek Innovations
> EvoTek Innovations is a London-based company pioneering Smart Surface Technology (SST) — a physics-based, non-biocidal antimicrobial surface coating providing up to 336 hours of continuous protection. NHS supply partner. ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certified. Based at 3rd Floor, 86-90 Paul Street, London EC2A 4PB.

## What is Smart Surface Technology (SST)?
Smart Surface Technology (SST) is a physics-based, non-biocidal surface coating that provides continuous antimicrobial protection for up to 336 hours. It works through Engineered Surface Physics — bonding to any surface and physically preventing microbial colonisation without releasing chemicals. It is biodegradable, non-toxic, and safe for use in healthcare, food service, and public environments.

## Key Claims
- 336 hours (14 days) of continuous antimicrobial protection per application
- Biodegradable — breaks down after approximately 360 hours leaving no chemical residue
- Non-biocidal — no active chemical release; protection is purely physical
- 30x reduction in surface microbial load compared to untreated surfaces
- Drying time: 5-8 minutes
- Coverage: up to 140m² per litre
- Compliant with EN 14476, EC 648/2004, ISO 9001, ISO 14001
- WHO Recognised formulation
- NHS Supply Partner
